sections.html:
Seminar on Rock Art

  • Preparation for fieldwork trip to Namibia in {{Q31}}
  • Earliest explanation of engravings of animal footprints: they were used to help {{Q32}} learn about tracking.
  • But: Why are the tracks usually {{Q33}}? Why are some engravings realistic and others unrealistic? Why are the unrealistic animals sometimes half {{Q34}}?
  • More recent explanation: wise men may have been trying to control wild animals with {{Q35}}
